title: Channel
description: A Restream channel representing a connected destination streaming platform account.

streamingPlatformId.description: ID of the associated streaming platform (e.g., 1=Twitch, 5=YouTube)

embedUrl.description: Embedded player URL for the channel

url.description: Channel URL on the destination platform

identifier.description: Platform-specific channel identifier (username, channel ID, etc.)

active.description: Whether the channel is currently active and will receive the stream
